# What are DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub really costing you?

> Free analyzer for restaurants: drop in your DoorDash, Uber Eats or Grubhub payout or order-level CSV and see the real take rate per platform and per order, net after food cost and packaging, losing orders, promo return and the markup that matches in-store margin. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
